dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave curvature along the trailing edge with a visible notch located on the posterior basal margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear incline at an approximately 55-degree angle relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is significantly greater than vertical height, approximately 1.5:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, large-radius convex arc characterizing the forehead region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short pixel length with a thick base and blunt terminal point relative to the cranial volume.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Clearly defined obtuse angle at the pixel junction where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible physical notch on the lower trailing edge of the dorsal fin; faint dark linear markings on the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Secondary vertical fin-like protrusion located on the dorsal side of the caudal peduncle, distinct from the primary dorsal fin and flukes.
